mapper.sql: f.id, f.uploader_user_id, f.original_name, f.storage_key, f.mime_type, f.size_bytes, f.sha256, f.width, f.height, f.state, f.owner_type, f.owner_id, f.sort_order, f.detached_at, f.reclaim_at, f.request_id
mapper.select: select from preg_file f where f.id = #{id} and f.del_flag = '0'
select from preg_file f where f.id = #{id} and f.del_flag = '0' for update
select from preg_file f where f.uploader_user_id = #{uploaderUserId} and f.request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into preg_file ( uploader_user_id, original_name, storage_key, mime_type, size_bytes, sha256, width, height, state, sort_order, request_id, del_flag, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{uploaderUserId}, #{originalName}, #{storageKey}, #{mimeType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{sha256}, #{width}, #{height}, #{state}, 0, #{requestId}, '0', now(3), now(3) )
mapper.update: update preg_file set state = 'BOUND', owner_type = #{ownerType}, owner_id = #{ownerId}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, detached_at = null, reclaim_at = null, update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and state in ('TEMP', 'ORPHAN') and del_flag = '0'

update preg_file set state = 'ORPHAN', detached_at = now(3), reclaim_at = #{reclaimAt}, update_time = now(3) where owner_type = #{ownerType} and owner_id = #{ownerId} and state = 'BOUND' and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select from preg_file f where f.owner_type = #{ownerType} and f.owner_id = #{ownerId} and f.state = 'BOUND' and f.del_flag = '0' order by f.sort_order asc, f.id asc

select from preg_file f where f.del_flag = '0' and ( (f.state = 'TEMP' and f.create_time <= #{tempCutoff}) or (f.state = 'ORPHAN' and f.reclaim_at <= now(3)) ) order by f.id asc limit #{limit} for update skip locked
mapper.update: update preg_file set state = 'DELETING', update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0' and state in ('TEMP', 'ORPHAN')
mapper.select: select from preg_file f where f.state = #{state} and f.del_flag = '0' order by f.id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.delete: delete from preg_file where id = #{id} and state = 'DELETING'
